items.title: Cyber Web Intel
items.summary: An AI-powered platform that monitors the dark web and the surface web for cyber threats, with automated analysis, dashboards and alerting for monitoring teams.

body.heading: What I built
paragraphs: I developed the platform’s AI-powered threat monitoring and integrated web intelligence collection with automated analysis across dark-web and surface-web sources.

body.heading: Operations
paragraphs: I designed the dashboards and alerting workflows that cyber monitoring operations run on.

items.title: Social Monitor
items.summary: A large-scale platform that collects, processes and analyses digital conversations across multiple social platforms for intelligence reporting in the APAC region.

body.heading: Signals from noise
paragraphs: Sentiment analysis, trend detection, topic clustering and entity extraction run on incoming conversations using AI and NLP techniques.

body.heading: Pipelines and reporting
paragraphs: I built scalable ingestion pipelines for structured and unstructured social media data, plus automated monitoring workflows and real-time dashboards for intelligence reporting.

items.title: AI Ticketing
items.summary: An enterprise-grade ticket management platform with intelligent ticket classification and workflow automation.

body.heading: Classification and automation
paragraphs: I designed and developed the platform, including intelligent ticket classification and workflow automation features.

body.heading: Security and operations
paragraphs: Secure backend APIs with role-based access control, reporting and operational monitoring dashboards, and a containerised deployment architecture using Docker.

items.title: Wallet Intel
items.summary: Blockchain intelligence work covering cryptocurrency wallet analysis, transaction tracing and risk assessment.

body.heading: Following the money
paragraphs: I conducted cryptocurrency wallet analysis and transaction tracing.

body.heading: Tooling
paragraphs: I built tools for blockchain monitoring and risk assessment.

items.title: Lead Engine
items.summary: An AI-assisted mini lead management system, built twice — Python with FastAPI and Node.js with TypeScript and Fastify — with verified feature parity.

body.heading: Two stacks, one contract
paragraphs: Both implementations share one feature set and are checked against 61 automated compliance checks, with 72 of 72 tests passing.

body.heading: AI and data quality
paragraphs: GPT-4o-mini assists the lead workflow, a two-stage blocking step removes duplicate leads, and lead sources are extracted with a three-tier fallback.

items.title: IDX Forecast
items.summary: Research on analysing and predicting Indonesia Stock Exchange share prices with Long Short-Term Memory networks, published in the Journal of Computer Science and Technology Studies.

body.heading: The study
paragraphs: Starting from my capstone on BBRI share prices, I compared machine learning models on IDX stocks, then implemented and validated an LSTM model for price analysis and prediction.

body.heading: Where it went
paragraphs: The work became my final project and a paper in Al-Kindi’s JCSTS in June 2024. A year earlier, at SENOVTIK 2023, I presented a comparison of KNN, linear regression and SVM for price prediction.
